title: Private Guided Pokemon Go Tour in Houston with Transportation
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
What kinds of rare Pokémon are hiding in Houston’s streets? Find out on our Pokémon GO tour! Tour the city while you catch Pokémon, visit Poké Stops, and battle at Gyms.
If you’re visiting Houston, you don’t want to leave without catching all the Pokémon in the area. While you’re playing the game, learn about the city and its history. This is a great experience for families and people of all ages!
The tour comes with your personal safety officer for you and your group. We offer curated tours for each visitor and provide you with a fun and memorable experience.
